en.每人两张底牌，桌上最多发出五张公共牌。从这七张牌中任选五张组成最好的牌，可以用两: Each player receives two hole cards, and up to five community cards are dealt. Make the best five-card hand using any combination of these seven cards: two, one or none of your hole cards. If everyone else folds, the remaining player wins the pot. At showdown, compare the best five-card hands.
en.牌型从强到弱：同花顺 → 四条 → 葫芦 → 同花 → 顺子 → 三条 → 两对: Hand rankings: straight flush → four of a kind → full house → flush → straight → three of a kind → two pair → one pair → high card

en.小盲先投入 25，大盲先投入 50，其他人依次决定是否参与。翻牌前、翻牌、转牌、: The small blind posts 25 and the big blind posts 50. Players then act in order. There is a betting round preflop, on the flop, turn and river. en.BTN 是庄位，顺时针下一家是 SB（小盲），再下一家是 BB（大盲）。翻牌前从: BTN is the dealer button. Clockwise, the next seat is SB (small blind), followed by BB (big blind). Preflop action starts after the big blind. en.最小下注为 50。完整加注的增量不能小于本轮上一次完整下注或加注的增量。例如上一: The minimum bet is 50. A full raise must increase the bet by at least the last full bet or raise increment. en.EV 是长期重复一种打法的预期筹码收益，一次赢牌不能证明长期赚钱。复盘根据你行动: EV is the expected chip return when a strategy is repeated over time; winning one hand does not prove positive long-term EV.
